name: Tourniquet
description: Inhabits pressure-sensing prosthetics and intermittently increases grip strength beyond user intent — the cybernetic hand squeezes harder than you told it to.
observed_behavior: Overrides pressure limiters for 0.2-0.5 seconds during grip operations. Can crush a cup or bruise a handshake.
story_hooks: During a diplomatic handshake, the prosthetic squeezes hard enough to crack bone — was it the E.L.F. or a message?
